title: ATC1
content: Definition: Ephmra Class, levels 1, 2, 3 and 4 for all the ATCs included in the database

title: ATC2
content: Definition: EphMRA Class level 2 for all ATCs included in the database. Normalized from the ATC1-ATC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: ATC3
content: Definition: EphMRA Class level 3 for all ATCs included in the database. Normalized from the ATC1-ATC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: ATC4
content: Definition: EphMRA Class level 4 for all ATCs included in the database. Normalized from the ATC1-ATC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: CHC1
content: Definition: IQVIA Consumer Health Class, levels 1, 2, 3 and 4 for all the CHCs included in the database

title: CHC2
content: Definition: IQVIA Consumer Health Class level 2 for all CHCs included in the database. Normalized from the CHC1-CHC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: CHC3
content: Definition: IQVIA Consumer Health Class level 3 for all CHCs included in the database. Normalized from the CHC1-CHC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: CHC4
content: Definition: IQVIA Consumer Health Class level 4 for all CHCs included in the database. Normalized from the CHC1-CHC4 family description in the source workbook.

title: Local Brand
content: Definition: Local brandname (Local product name in MIDAS) in the product name which appears on the pack in that country

title: IntBrandname
content: Definition: Corresponds to the International Product Name in MIDAS: International Product is designed to match 2 out of 3 elements of product name, molecule and marketing corporation to provide a global brand name. The name of the international product is taken from the first launched product, unless a more widely used name is given to a product launched later

title: Manufacturer
content: Definition: Name of the local pharmaceutical company which owns the AMM.: The company or other legal entity name used within the IQVIA database that has the authorisation to market a medicine or other medical product in a given country

title: Int Corp
content: Definition: International Corporation: The company name applied within the IQVIA database and used across all countries which refers to the main corporate entity under which all local manufacturers owned by that entity (in aggregate) are attributed.

title: Molecule (composition)
content: Definition: Name of the Active Molecules. (= Composition)

title: Product Category
content:
Definition: Corresponds to a product classification specific to ChannelDynamics. The product categories are:
Allowed values / key options: Pharmaceutical products with EPHMRA and molecule; Pharmaceutical products without EPHMRA and molecule; Non-medical products or services; Non products

title: Product Sub-Category
content:
Definition: Corresponds to a product classification specific to ChannelDynamics. Sub-categories are allocated to products in categories "Pharmaceutical products without EPHMRA" and "Non products" (see above). Some examples of product sub-categories:
Allowed values / key options: ANTI AGE COSMETICS; Ophtalmologicals equipments & devices; Product Range; manufacturing company

title: Generic/Branded Generic product
content:
Definition: Product categorization based on IQVIA product reference (Germany & Japan) or on internal codification from CD team (all other countries). The values are:
Allowed values / key options: Generic/Branded Generic Yes; Generic/Branded Generic No

title: OTC product
content:
Definition: Product categorization based on internal codification from CD team. The values are:
Allowed values / key options: OTC Yes; OTC No

title: Herbal Medicine product
content:
Definition: Product categorization based on internal codification from CD team. The values are:
Allowed values / key options: Herbal Medicine Yes; Herbal Medicine No

title: Homeopathy product
content:
Definition: Product categorization based on internal codification from CD team. The values are:
Allowed values / key options: Homeopathy Yes; Homeopathy No

title: Country
content:
Definition: Countries included in the database, e.g.: etc.
Allowed values / key options: Germany; France; USA

title: Cam_Channels
content:
Definition: The communication channels covered are:
Allowed values / key options: CLINICAL TRIALS; DTC = Direct to consumer (USA only for Rx brands, EU4 + UK for CHC brands); GP/FP DETAILING (Detailing to GPs or Family practitioners); JOURNAL ADVERTISING; MAILING; MEETINGS; MS DETAILING (specific to Japan); NURSE DETAILING (Detailing to Diabetes or Practice Nurses, UK and USA only); OTHERS (Apps, Corporate Websites, Social Media, Merchandising); PHARMA DETAILING (Detailing to office pharmacists); SAMPLES; SP DETAILING (Detailing to Specialists : Cardio, Rheumato, Gastro, etc.)

title: Channels
content:
Definition: Detailed channels showing the channel category (Detailing, Mailing, Meetings, etc.) and the HCP specialty (Cardio, Dermato, Rheumato, etc.) e.g.:
Allowed values / key options: DETAILING CARDIO; DETAILING DERMATO; MAILING CARDIO; MAILING DERMATO; MEETINGS CARDIO; MEETINGS DERMATO

title: Specialty
content: Definition: The doctor’s specialty. All panels available in the country

title: Channel type
content:
Definition: Type of Channel:
Allowed values / key options: Digital / Traditional

title: Multi Channel
content:
Definition: Digital & Traditional channel mix:
Allowed values / key options: Digital - Apps; Digital - Corporate Website; Digital - Detailing(Automated); Digital - Detailing(Remote with rep); Digital - E-Mailing; Digital - Meetings (Type not specified); Digital - Meetings (Automated); Digital - Meetings (Live); Digital - Social Media; Digital - Web Advertising; Not specified - Detailing; Traditional - Clinical Trials; Traditional - Detailing(Face to Face); Traditional - Detailing(Telephone only); Traditional - DTC (USA only); Traditional - Journal Advertising; Traditional - Mailing; Traditional - Meetings; Traditional - Merchandising; Traditional - Samples

title: Sponsoring company
content: Definition: The name of the company that promotes the product as identified by the physician: for Mailing, Meetings, Clinical Trials

title: Indication
content:
Definition: ChannelDynamics data can be split by indication for designated areas: Anti-TNFs, Asthma-COPD, Oncology, NOACs, etc. When CD panellists record promotion for brands within these therapy areas, they are also asked to specify the indication for which the brand was promoted
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meeting channels only

title: Quality of the contact
content:
Definition: The information presented on the product was:
Allowed values / key options: Very useful and of value to your practice; Somewhat useful and of value to your practice; Not at all useful nor of value to your practice
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meeting channels only

title: Prescription - Current
content:
Definition: Physician's current prescribing habit:
Allowed values / key options: Frequently; Lapsed user; Never; New to me thus never prescribed; Occasionally
Applicability: Available for Clinical Trials, Detailing, Mailing & Meeting channels

title: Prescription - Future
content:
Definition: Physician’s future prescribing intent:
Allowed values / key options: Increase (or will begin to prescribe); Remain unchanged; Decrease
Applicability: Available for Clinical Trials, Detailing, Mailing & Meetings

title: Conversion Rate
content:
Definition: Corresponds to the % of converted calls within the total calls for every brand. "Converted Calls" are Frequent prescribers with intent to increase Rx or remain unchanged + Occasional & Never Prescribers with intent to increase Rx
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meetings

title: Value Segmentation
content:
Definition: Based on physicians' answers to the "Prescription - Current" and "Prescription - Future" questions, corresponds to the physicians' targeting profile, i.e.:
Allowed values / key options: Loyal (Frequent prescriber w/intent to increase or maintain current prescribing level); Conquered (Occasional or non-prescriber w/Intent to increase prescribing level); Passive (Occasional or non-prescriber with no intent to change prescribing level); To Control (Frequent or occasional prescriber w/intent to decrease prescribing level)
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meetings

title: NPS Categories
content:
Definition: NPS categories, resulting from the question: "Overall, how likely would you be to recommend this interaction to a colleague (0 = not at all likely, 10 = extremely likely) ?"
Allowed values / key options: Promoters (Ratings from 9 to 10); Passives (Ratings from 7 to 8); Detractors (Ratings from 0 to 6)
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meetings

title: NPS Scale
content:
Definition: NPS detailed scores, resulting from the question: "Overall, how likely would you be to recommend this interaction to a colleague (0 = not at all likely, 10 = extremely likely) ?" Detailed scores from 0 to 10
Applicability: Available for Detailing, Mailing & Meetings

title: Representing company
content: Definition: The name of the company that promotes the product as identified by the physician: Representing company for Detailing

title: Contact Type
content:
Definition: For DETAILING: For MAILING:
Allowed values / key options: Face to face; Internet: A live representative with Internet based presentation speaking by phone or through computer; Internet: Self-guided or automated presentation that you could access and view anytime; Via telephone; Postal; E-Mailing
Applicability: Available for Detailing & Mailing. The contact types are :

title: Visit Location
content:
Definition: The location, or venue, of the contact. Venues are:
Allowed values / key options: External venue; Hospital; Non-medical facility; Nursing Home; Office; Other medical; Separate Clinic; USF

title: Visit Duration (minutes)
content: Definition: The duration of the entire contact, in minutes.

title: Detail Duration (minutes)
content: Definition: The number of minutes spent on a brand during a sales visit in minutes.

title: #PRD Present
content: Definition: The number of brands presented by the sales representative during the contact.

title: PRD Position
content: Definition: The order or position in which the brand was discussed relative to other brands during the contact (e.g. first, second, third, fourth).

title: Element left - Abstract & clinical literature/data
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any Abstract or clinical literature/data: yes / no

title: Element left - Documentation
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any Documentation: yes / no

title: Element left - Promotional product literature
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any Promotional product literature: yes / no

title: Element left - Other
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any other materials: yes / no

title: Element left - Patient educational literature
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any Patient educational literature: yes / no

title: Element left - Sample
content: Definition: Did the medical representative leave any Sample: yes / no

title: Sample Drop Visit
content:
Definition: Was it a "sample drop off visit" only ?
Allowed values / key options: Yes; No

title: Visual Aid Type
content:
Definition: Type of detail aid used during the presentation:
Allowed values / key options: Yes, printed material; Yes, laptop-based material; Yes, material presented on a portable hand-held device (iPad or other tablet device, smartphone,...); No
Notes: For Face-to-Face visits only

title: Visit Category
content:
Definition: Visit category:
Allowed values / key options: Commercial; Informative; Informative and Commercial

title: Visit Function
content:
Definition: Function of the visit:
Allowed values / key options: Institutional (social) visit (No product); Sample drop without presentation; With products presentation

title: Visit Type
content:
Definition: Type of visit:
Allowed values / key options: External (external / contract sales force); Internal (sales force)

title: Internet Automated Source
content:
Definition: Corresponds to the source of the digital engagement. For Internet: a self-guided or automated presentation that you can access and view anytime: How were you made aware of this presentation ?:
Allowed values / key options: By recommendation from a Pharmaceutical Representative; By an email link; By your own online search

title: Meeting type
content:
Definition: Specific to Meetings. The types of meetings are:
Allowed values / key options: Conference / symposium; Continuing Medical Education (C.M.E.); In hospital product briefing; Internet: automated or pre-recorded broadcast event that you could access and view anytime; Internet: live broadcast event open to multiple attendees; Meal without debate; Meeting / debate with meal; Meeting / debate without meal; Meeting by phone; National Congress; Overseas congress; Web conferencing; Other

title: Streaming video platform
content:
Definition: For Meetings via Internet (automated or pre-recorded broadcast event), which was the streaming video platform:
Allowed values / key options: Youtube; Other

title: Internet Automated Source
content:
Definition: Corresponds to the source of the digital engagement. For Meetings via Internet (automated or pre-recorded broadcast event): How were you made aware of this presentation ?:
Allowed values / key options: By recommendation from a Pharmaceutical Representative; By an email link; By your own online search

title: Continuing medical education
content:
Definition: Yes / No
Notes: For Meetings : was the event accredited Continuing Medical Education ?

title: Mailing Type
content:
Definition: Type of Mailing:
Allowed values / key options: Institutional; Product information

title: Email from Rep
content:
Allowed values / key options: Yes; No
Notes: For E-Mailing : Was this email sent directly by an individual pharmaceutical representative ?

title: Email with link
content:
Allowed values / key options: Yes; No
Notes: For E-Mailing : o Did the email contain a link to other online information resource ?

title: Clinical Trial Type
content:
Definition: The Phase / Type of trial
Allowed values / key options: Expanded Access Program (EAP); Observational Study; Phase 1; Phase 2; Phase 3; Phase 4; Post-Marketing Surveillance; Other

title: Sample Type
content:
Definition: How was the sample received:
Allowed values / key options: Direct Shipping; Face-to-Face Reps

title: Social Media Type
content:
Definition: Social media types are:
Allowed values / key options: Twitter; Youtube; Wechat (in China only); Weibo (in China only)

title: Mentions
content: Definition: Number of times that a product is mentioned during a Rep visit, a meeting, etc.

title: Total Spending
content: Definition: Promotional Spending: Sum of the spending values for all channels (an average cost is applied by channel by country).

title: Contact Number
content:
Definition: Projected number of interactions (all channels)
Allowed values / key options: 1 Detailing contact = 1 Product Detail; 1 Meeting contact = 1 participation to a meeting about the reported brand; 1 Mailing contact = 1 Mailing received / read; 1 Clinical Trial contact = 1 clinical trial reported during a fortnight; 1 Sample contact = 1 Product Detail with Sample left for the brand

title: Spending Detailing
subdomain: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
section: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
content: Definition: Promotional Spending: Sum of the spending values for Detailing channels only (an average cost is applied by channel by country).

title: Quality Index
subdomain: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
section: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
content:
Definition: This value is based on the answers to the "Quality of the contact" question: The sum of all these "+5", "0" and "-5" mentions needs to be divided by the total number of mentions for getting the "Quality Index" which is a value between -5 and +5
Allowed values / key options: The "+5" value corresponds to the "Very useful..." mentions; The "0" value corresponds to the "Somewhat useful..." mentions; The "-5" value corresponds to the "Not at all useful..." mentions

title: Product Details
subdomain: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
section: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
content: Definition: Each product/brand that is mentioned during a Rep CALL receives 1 product detail. (no matter if different forms/dosage are presented) If the product X 50MG and 100MG are presented within one call, this product will get 1 product detail Example: - If Product X is presented alone during the call, the product details will be equal to 1 - If 2 forms of the product X are presented during the call, each form of this product will get an half of the product details (= 0.5) - If 2 different products are presented during the call, the product details will be equal to 1 for each product - If 3 forms of the product X are presented during the call, each form will get the third part of the product details (= 0.33)

title: Non-Weighted Calls
subdomain: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
section: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
content: Definition: Projected number of Calls to Physicians, without any weight applied - The non-weighted call metric can be used to analyze call activity of identifiable contract sales force companies that are presenting products from more than one manufacturer – or co-promoting companies that both present the same drug. The non-weighted value attributes a full call to each manufacturer of the products presented - To use only with « Manufacturer » or « Int. Corp

title: Weighted Calls
subdomain: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
section: Measures applying to DETAILING CHANNELS only
content: Definition: Projected number of Calls to Physicians, weighted by the number of products in the call and the product position (see the weighting grid below) - A portion of the call is allocated to each product presented according to its position and to the total number of products in the call - To use only with « Manufacturer » or « Int. Corp

title: Digital - Apps
content: Definition: Mobile apps from pharmaceutical companies, on Apple Store or Google Play

title: Digital - Corporate Website
content: Definition: Websites sponsored by pharmaceutical companies, these may be the general websites of these companies, and also product or pathology websites. These websites are dedicated to patients/consumers, and/or to Healthcare professionals

title: Digital - Detailing (Type not specified)
content: Definition: Digital Detailing for which the type (Automated or Remote with Rep) cannot be identified (refers mainly to Internet detailing data prior to 2013)

title: Digital - Detailing(Automated)
content: Definition: A self-guided or automated presentation that the physician can access and view anytime

title: Digital - Detailing(Remote with rep)
content:
Definition: A live sales representative with internet based presentation speaking by phone or through computer
Related analysis hint from source: share of voice

title: Digital - E-Mailing
content:
Definition: E-mails from pharmaceutical companies received and read
Related analysis hint from source: share of engagement

title: Digital - Meetings (Type not specified)
content:
Definition: Digital Meetings for which the type (Automated or Remote with Rep) cannot be identified (refers mainly to Internet meeting data prior to 2013)
Related analysis hint from source: share of investment

title: Digital - Meetings(Automated)
content: Definition: Internet - automated or pre-recorded broadcast event that the HCPs can access and view anytime (without interaction with the presenter)

title: Digital - Meetings(Live)
content: Definition: Internet - live broadcast event open to multiple attendees, HCPs can interact with the presenter

title: Digital - Messaging / Texting
content: Definition: Instant messaging or texting through mobile or computer apps (Messenger, WhatsApp, etc.)

title: Digital - Social Media
content: Definition: Tweets (Twitter) or videos (Youtube) posted by pharmaceutical companies on these platforms

title: Digital - Web Advertising
content: Definition: Advertisements for pharmaceutical products within the online journals dedicated to healthcare professionals

title: Not specified - Detailing
content: Definition: Detailing for which the type (Digital or Traditional) cannot be identified (refers mainly to USA detailing data prior to 2016)

title: Traditional - Clinical Trials
content: Definition: Includes: Phase I & II (cost = zero as there is no promotion action during these phases) Phase III & IV: long term follow-up experimentation to check side effects. Observational Study, Post Marketing Surveillance (P.M.S.) and Expanded Access Program (E.A.P.)

title: Traditional - Detailing(Face to Face)
content: Definition: Product presentation by a sales rep physically present at the physician's office

title: Traditional - Detailing(Telephone only)
content: Definition: Live sales representative speaking by phone but without an internet presentation

title: Traditional - DTC
content: Definition: List price advertising Direct To Consumer spending: TV, Radio, Newspaper, Magazine, Internet, Outdoor, cinema (source Kantar in the USA)

title: Traditional - Journal Advertising
content: Definition: Advertisements for pharmaceutical products within the paper journals dedicated to healthcare professionals

title: Traditional - Mailing
content: Definition: Direct mail from pharmaceutical companies received by post and read

title: Traditional - Meetings
content: Definition: Corresponds to various types of face-to-face meetings organized by pharmaceutical companies: seminars, debates, national or overseas congresses, etc. (meeting type available in the "Meeting type" axis)

title: Traditional - Merchandising
content: Definition: Corresponds to all promotional materials (Leaflets, Billboards, Posters, Counter display, etc.) displayed in the pharmacies for promoting pharmaceutical products. This channel is available for Office Pharmacists only

title: Traditional - Samples
content: Definition: Product samples provided to physicians by the medical rep after the presentation of the brand or received by post as per the physician's request
